description: This is a test class for the BuzzLikeDao in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, containing unit tests for saving, deleting, and retrieving 'like' entities related to shares and comments within the Buzz module.
external_files: OrangeHRM	ests in	estcase ramework rameworkTestCase

classes.name: BuzzLikeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing BuzzLikeDao functionalities such as saving, deleting, and fetching likes on shares and comments within the Buzz module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating instances, mocking services, and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnShare entity and verifies the associated employee, share, and timestamp data.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnComment entity with assertions on employee, comment, and timestamp.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzLikeOnShare and asserts the removal from the repository and count updates.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzLikeOnComment and validates repository updates.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare by share ID and employee number and verifies the data.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment by comment ID and employee number and verifies the data.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Fetches a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities filtered by share ID and checks their correctness.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of likes on shares for various share IDs.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities filtered by comment ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of likes on comments for different comment IDs.
